Overview

Guimarães is a city in with a population of 52,181. Birthplace of Portugal, a UNESCO World Heritage city with a beautifully preserved medieval center and rich history. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
